title: Make caml_darken do cmpxchg on lazy/forcing header words

target.summary: The condition checking for lazy and forcing blocks requires both `Lazy_tag` and `Forcing_tag` simultaneously (`&&`), which can never be satisfied. Consequently, `mark_header` never executes the compare-and-exchange branch, allowing concurrent header updates to lazy or forcing blocks to be overwritten with relaxed stores and leading to heap corruption or crashes.
notes: faulty condition requiring both Lazy_tag and Forcing_tag with && instead of ||
